Shipping FAQ

Answers to the questions customers ask most about delivery. Last updated 2026-09-30.

How long does delivery take?

Most parcels arrive in two to four working days. Remote areas may take longer.

RegionStandardExpress
East China2 daysNext day
South China3 daysNext day
Remote areas5 to 7 days, no express

What does shipping cost?

  • Free on orders over 49 yuan
  • Gold members: two free shipping coupons a month
    • Coupons do not roll over
  • Otherwise 8 yuan per order

How do I track a parcel?

  1. Open your orders.
  2. Choose the order and tap Track.

Internal note: do not show.

Tip: tracking numbers appear within an hour of dispatch.
